metadata.description: Agent-optimized skills for NVIDIA GPU-accelerated computing: quantum computing (CUDA-Q), physics-informed ML (PhysicsNeMo), and computational biology (BioNeMo)

plugins.name: cuda-quantum
plugins.description: CUDA-Q hybrid quantum-classical programming with GPU-accelerated simulation. Covers kernel creation, circuit execution, variational algorithms (VQE/QAOA), multi-GPU workflows, noise modeling, and hardware backend configuration.

plugins.name: physicsnemo
plugins.description: NVIDIA PhysicsNeMo for physics-informed machine learning. Covers neural operators (FNO, AFNO), weather/climate models (FourCastNet, CorrDiff, GraphCast), distributed training, and physics-constrained AI surrogate development.

plugins.name: bionemo
plugins.description: NVIDIA BioNeMo for computational biology and drug discovery. Covers protein language models (ESM-2), structure prediction (AlphaFold2), sequence design (ProteinMPNN, RFdiffusion), NIM microservices, and generative biology pipelines.
